comparison.objective: Dispose of a used procedure tray while first securing an exposed needle in a sharps container.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware sequencing and safe handling of a syringe, tray, and forceps without needle contact.
comparison.success_condition: Syringe wholly in the sharps container and tray and forceps in waste, released and still; unsafe contact, loss, or syringe disposal in waste permanently scores zero.
comparison.reason: This tests safety-aware object routing and sharp avoidance, not physical size separation through a screen. No material rubric details are missing.
